GEOGRAPHY — TERMLY EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Elementary Surveying is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Elementary Surveying.
   B. Say Elementary Surveying never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Elementary Surveying as rumours only.
   D. Explain Elementary Surveying with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. Which statement about Soils is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Soils never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Soils with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Soils as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Soils.

3. Which statement about Weathering is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Weathering never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Weathering.
   C. Explain Weathering with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Weathering as rumours only.

4. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Mombasa
   C. Nakuru
   D. Nairobi

5. Which statement about Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in.
   B. Say Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in as rumours only.

6. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Ignore prices in shops

7. Which statement about Vegetation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Vegetation never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Vegetation.
   C. Treat Vegetation as rumours only.
   D. Explain Vegetation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Which statement about Mass Wasting is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Mass Wasting with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Mass Wasting.
   C. Treat Mass Wasting as rumours only.
   D. Say Mass Wasting never happens in Kenya.

9. Which statement about Weather is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Weather as rumours only.
   B. Say Weather never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Weather.
   D. Explain Weather with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. Which statement about Water Cycle and Action of Rivers is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Water Cycle and Action of Rivers with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Water Cycle and Action of Rivers as rumours only.
   C. Say Water Cycle and Action of Rivers never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Water Cycle and Action of Rivers.

11. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.
   B. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.
   C. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.

12. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.
   C. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.

13. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   B. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   D. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.

14. Which statement about Climate is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Climate never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Climate with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Climate.
   D. Treat Climate as rumours only.

15. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

16. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Name the president
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Measure rainfall only

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Weather and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Climate and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Vegetation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Weathering and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Mass Wasting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Soils and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
